turning_points.description: Opens the fence preventing access to Saltmere.
Moves the horse-drawn carriage blocking the street to the church district.
Spawns Eris in the church side alley.
Grants entry to the main hall of the church.
Spawns Felix's market stall near the church.
Spawns Lenore on the hilltop ruins.
Allows entrance to the protagonist's inn room.
Allows the player to exit the inn after the dream.
Player can now navigate to the forest and runic cave.
Triggers the orb of truth confession scene with Eris and Solon.
Spawns Lenore for the final resolution at the hilltop ruins.
